title: Nonlinear Curvature-Free Periodic Folding in Origami via Symmetry Classification of Linear Modes
summary: Broadly studied origami crease patterns such as the Miura-ori are capable of rigid folding that maintains their spatial periodicity. However, periodic crease patterns generically require additional creases and fold into quasi-cylindrical shapes. Here, using group theory, we show that the folding properties of such sheets are largely determined by their spatial symmetries, known as layer groups.
